nodes.label: Phases are the smart-plan source of truth
nodes.description: After phases exist, smart_plans is a compatibility container; phase goals/dates/days/ranges drive edits and parent bounds.
nodes.norm_label: phases are the smart-plan source of truth
nodes.rationale: Keep one authoritative plan representation.

nodes.label: No overlapping phases with historical identity
nodes.description: Allow one memorization plus one sard phase, prevent overlaps, show gaps and forbid changing a phase type with student history.
nodes.norm_label: no overlapping phases with historical identity
nodes.rationale: Preserve timeline and historical identity.

nodes.label: Unambiguous phase backfill
nodes.description: Historical recitations receive phase_id only with a unique unambiguous match; tests are excluded from Sard Anchor.
nodes.rationale: Avoid incorrect historical reassignment.

nodes.label: Atomic idempotent phase transition
nodes.description: One atomic idempotent RPC ends memorization, starts sard and writes events; per-student sard targets may override.
nodes.rationale: Preserve all-or-nothing transition behavior.

nodes.label: Phase revision conflict safety
nodes.description: Phase edits use revision and expose a conflict rather than overwriting another device.
nodes.rationale: Protect concurrent edits.

nodes.label: SardAnchorResolver chronology
nodes.description: SardAnchorResolver uses session_date then created_at; a general test does not advance the anchor.
nodes.rationale: Preserve the correct recitation chronology.

nodes.label: Phase lifecycle and frozen results
nodes.description: Scheduled/Active/Ended/Completed lifecycle reconciles ended phases; changing dates must not reset frozen results.
nodes.rationale: Phase state is real domain behavior, not only UI.

nodes.label: Admin-only approval of staff contests
nodes.description: Admin alone approves teacher/supervisor contests; admin-created contests approve immediately.
nodes.rationale: One reviewer and reuse of the existing approval screen.

nodes.label: Admin contest reminder
nodes.description: Admins receive the staff contest-proposal reminder.
nodes.rationale: Same reminder behavior as staff.

nodes.label: Contribution navigation uses drawer and More
nodes.description: Contribution is available for four roles in Drawer/More; a Home shortcut remains a later step.
nodes.norm_label: contribution navigation uses drawer and more
nodes.rationale: Avoid adding a new bottom tab.

nodes.label: Guardian payment-card visibility
nodes.description: Guardians see the existing donor-card payment JSON controlled by admin.
nodes.rationale: Reuse of the existing payment card contract.

nodes.label: Keep donor_id and add creator_role
nodes.description: Keep donor_id as creator ID; add creator_role rather than renaming donor_id.
nodes.rationale: Avoid column rename migration risk.

nodes.label: Guardian sponsorship limited to child halaqat
nodes.description: Only sponsorship cards for the guardian children’s halaqat are visible; unscoped cards remain hidden.
nodes.norm_label: guardian sponsorship limited to child halaqat
nodes.rationale: Preserve the guardian scope.

nodes.label: Weekly reminder default
nodes.description: Reminders default to Thursday 18:00 Asia/Gaza; users can disable or change time; permission is requested when enabled.
nodes.rationale: Role-specific reminder text and user control.

nodes.label: Contest halaqa is mandatory
nodes.description: Teachers without a halaqa are blocked with a clear message; admin also must select a halaqa.
nodes.rationale: An approved contest must target a halaqa.

nodes.label: Approximate reminders via WorkManager
nodes.description: Use a one-time WorkManager chain rather than AlarmManager.
nodes.rationale: No special permission; timing drift is acceptable for reminders.

nodes.label: Account-scoped durable Room outbox
nodes.rationale: Critical edits persist locally before upload; restart must not erase pending operations. Room cache/outbox/sync state are account scoped.

nodes.label: Connectivity-constrained unique WorkManager sync
nodes.rationale: Periodic and one-shot work use CONNECTED, unique KEEP, and exponential backoff.

nodes.label: Explicit updated_at conflict resolution
nodes.rationale: A changed server record becomes a conflict; never silently discard or overwrite the user version. User chooses local or server.

nodes.label: Non-destructive RC6 import
nodes.rationale: One-time import retains old databases for rollback rather than deleting them.

nodes.label: Per-student deduplicated upsert
nodes.rationale: Sequential student changes collapse to the latest snapshot; SupabaseApi.raw sets merge-duplicates for on_conflict requests.

nodes.label: RC7 offline-first contract
nodes.rationale: Room is the local source of truth; Supabase remains the cloud source of truth and existing RLS remains authoritative.

nodes.label: Readable cached snapshots while offline
nodes.rationale: Session/plan/master-data cache does not expire during network loss.

nodes.label: Donor contests contract
nodes.rationale: Design note precedes implementation and records a migration file that was not applied by the note; verify actual deployment before assuming RPC availability.

nodes.label: Admin-only pending contest decision
nodes.rationale: Only pending to approved/rejected; approval needs a halaqa and rejection needs a reason. Double decisions are rejected server-side.

nodes.label: Deleted halaqa contest visibility
nodes.rationale: on-delete-set-null retains historical contests; approved unassigned rows become admin-only until reassigned.

nodes.label: Donor is observer role
nodes.rationale: Existing donor_halaqas links are reused; no additional donor-to-circle link table is needed.

nodes.label: Halaqa-scoped contest RLS
nodes.rationale: Donors submit/update their own pending rows; admins decide; related users read approved contests within their halaqat; no delete policy.

nodes.label: Idempotent contest notifications
nodes.rationale: Unique recipient_id plus source_key and on-conflict-do-nothing prevent notification duplicates.

nodes.label: Offline contest reads and online-only writes
nodes.norm_label: offline contest reads and online-only writes
nodes.rationale: Stored RPC lists are readable offline; writes require connection. Missing migration/RPC yields a friendly Arabic message.

nodes.label: Pinned privileged contest helpers
nodes.rationale: SECURITY DEFINER helpers use public, pg_temp search_path and RPC execution is revoked from public/anon; helper membership checks avoid joined-table RLS hiding rows.

nodes.label: Shared role-based contest navigation
nodes.rationale: AppDestination and RoleNavigationPolicy define navigation, FeatureRouter routes screens, and GoldenShell groups the drawer.

nodes.label: RC100 backup and certificate hardening
nodes.description: Legacy halaqati-cache.db is excluded from backups and removed after import; certificate style is escaped.
nodes.rationale: Limit legacy cache exposure and unsafe certificate markup.

nodes.label: RC100 persisted-data limits and rankings
nodes.description: Plans/phases/reports do not stop at legacy row caps; newest recitations survive caps; cancelled sessions are excluded from ranking.
nodes.rationale: Avoid silent truncation and inaccurate progress/ranking.

nodes.label: RC100 ordered durable synchronization
nodes.description: RPC operations are ordered behind the queue; rejected session deletion is surfaced as blocked; local retry attempts are bounded.
nodes.rationale: Do not silently discard rejected deletion or retry forever.

nodes.label: RC100 trusted updater
nodes.description: Self-updates require valid SHA-256 and an approved host.
nodes.rationale: Reject unverified update packages.

nodes.label: RC100 signout preserves pending writes
nodes.description: Signout revokes the server session and removes downloaded student data while preserving unuploaded changes.
nodes.rationale: Preserve pending edits while removing account-downloaded data.

nodes.label: RC100 auth callback origin binding
nodes.description: Token-bearing login/recovery links are accepted only when this device requested them for the same account.
nodes.rationale: Prevent another app or page from installing an attacker session.

nodes.label: Historical anonymous definer RPC exposure
nodes.rationale: Review reported anonymous execution on guardian/ranking range RPCs and five functions lacking audited definitions; do not change missing definitions blindly.

nodes.label: Historical leaked-password-protection setting finding
nodes.rationale: Review reported the Auth setting disabled; fixing this needs an authorized Auth configuration change, not application-code guesses.

nodes.label: Historical mutable search_path finding
nodes.rationale: touch_notification_updated_at had mutable search_path at review time; verify current definition before remediation.

nodes.label: Historical Supabase security review 2026-09-09
nodes.rationale: Read-only advisor findings from the older Native migration; these are historical findings and not a claim about current live state.

nodes.label: Review-only SQL is not a production migration
nodes.norm_label: review-only sql is not a production migration
nodes.rationale: Security review SQL deliberately lives outside supabase/migrations to prevent accidental production application.

nodes.label: Server-only RLS table without client policies
nodes.norm_label: server-only rls table without client policies
nodes.rationale: RLS enabled with zero policies may be intentional for an internal server-only secrets table; do not add a client policy without intent.

nodes.label: RC114 contribution feature
nodes.description: Release 2.91.14 documents guardian sponsorship and contests/reminders for guardian, teacher, supervisor and admin.
nodes.rationale: Release behavior is documented; current deployed database state is not independently checked here.

nodes.label: RC114 staff contests migration
nodes.description: The release note references 20261126_v2921_staff_contests_guardian_sponsorship.sql.
nodes.rationale: The note reports production application and rollback-transaction testing; this graph does not independently verify production.

nodes.label: RC114 local reminders
nodes.description: WorkManager reminders are local, use an independent notification channel and do not read the database.
nodes.rationale: Users can disable them and timing is approximate.
